setting.help: Use your own endpoint for Partner Hub customer conversations. Other native Odoo AI features are unchanged.

field.name: b2b_ai_third_party_model
field.placeholder: Exact model ID from your provider

div.p: Enter the API base URL, including /v1 if required, but not /chat/completions. Requires Chat Completions with JSON output. API keys stay server-side. Saving does not call the provider.

Product and FAQ lookup retain existing permissions. Document indexing and vector search still require the native OpenAI embedding key. Do not replace existing vectors with a different embedding model.

button.name: action_b2b_ai_test_provider
button.confirm: Send a small test prompt to this endpoint using the entered key? This may incur a small charge. No customer or product data will be sent.

setting.help: Save embedding settings for compatibility testing. This does not activate a new index provider.

div.p: Use the API base URL without /embeddings. The provider must support OpenAI-compatible embeddings with 1536-dimensional output. Reuse the chat key only if it is authorized for this embedding endpoint.
div.div: Pending compatibility testing. Saving sends no API requests and does not switch document indexing or query embeddings. Existing documents are not reindexed. Provider activation and any required reindexing will be handled after testing.
